sections.question: How many distinct five-character ECCNs named in the 2026 UAE rule's § 742.6(a)(6)(iii)(B) were absent from the January 2023 Macau rule's § 742.6(a)(6)?
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Source fact (Doc 6, amendment 7, which revises § 742.6(a)(6)(iii)(B); the rule is effective July 10, 2026): the revised license requirement for the UAE and Country Groups D:1, D:4 or D:5 covers items specified in ECCNs 3A001 (z paragraphs), 3A090.b, 3D001, 3E001, 4A003 (z paragraphs), 4A004.z.2, 4A005.z.2, 4A090.b, 4D001, 4D090, 4E001, 5A002 (z paragraphs), 5A004 (z paragraphs), 5A992.z.2, 5D002 (z paragraphs), 5D992.z.2, 5E002 and 5E992.

Step 2. Source fact (Doc 1, amendment 9, which revises § 742.6(a)(6); the rule is effective January 17, 2023): paragraph (a)(6)(i) requires a license for China or Macau for items specified in ECCNs 3A090, 3B090, 4A090 and 5A992 (meeting the 3A090 or 4A090 parameters) and associated software and technology in 3D001, 3E001, 4D090, 4E001 and 5D992 (meeting the same parameters); paragraph (a)(6)(ii) names no ECCN.

Step 3. Matching (Doc 6 and Doc 1): reduced to five-character ECCNs, Step 1's 5A992.z.2 is ECCN 5A992 and 5D992.z.2 is ECCN 5D992, so the ECCNs named in both texts are 3A090, 3D001, 3E001, 4A090, 4D090, 4E001, 5A992 and 5D992; 3B090 is named only in 2023.

Step 4. Exclusion (Doc 6 and Doc 1): Step 1's ECCNs absent from Step 2 are, in Category 3, 3A001; in Category 4, 4A003, 4A004, 4A005 and 4D001; in Category 5, 5A002, 5A004, 5D002, 5E002 and 5E992.

Step 5. Calculation (Doc 6 and Doc 1): new Category 4 and Category 5 ECCNs from Step 4: 4 + 5 = 9.

Step 6. Calculation (Doc 6 and Doc 1): adding Category 3's 3A001: 9 + 1 = 10 distinct five-character ECCNs named in 2026 but not in 2023.

Step 7. Look-alike check (Doc 1): the preamble's list of the seven ECCNs whose RS control paragraphs gained Macau leaves out 5A992 and 5D992, which § 742.6(a)(6)(i) itself names; counting against that list instead would give 12.
